fields.description: Base URL of the Shukhee REST API, e.g. https://dev-api.shukhee.com
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Host for the video-call WebView join URL -- a different service from the REST API base_url, e.g. https://dev-ssk.grameendhs.com
fields.label: Video Call Base URL

fields.description: Server-side kill-switch for the Shukhee teleconsult ("Call a doctor") feature, read by shukhee_integration.api.settings.get_controls. uhis_lf_mobile ANDs this with its own build-time TELECONSULT_ENABLED flag -- both must be true for the feature to appear. Defaults OFF so a build compiled with TELECONSULT_ENABLED=true does not surface the feature against a backend whose Shukhee gateway route hasn't been verified working yet. Flip on only once this environment is confirmed working end-to-end.
fields.label: Teleconsult Enabled

fields.description: Never read by the mobile API -- exists only so the Desk UI can embed a live grid of Shukhee Consent rows via this field's sva_ft Property Setter (Custom grid: Consents).
fields.label: Consents
